answer: Finality is K-of-N: a reward posts only after K independent, already-established peers countersign the same action. A lone key cannot self-finalize, so one clone signing a thousand times still gathers zero valid countersignatures and its ripple dies at the source. To forge a single settlement an attacker must separately establish, fund, and keep honest K distinct identities; a fresh wallet is a wharf with no ship moored, an oasis that proves dry. Cost scales linearly with K per fake, never with cheap raw clone count.
